seo.title: ASSERT | AI, Computer Vision & IoT Solutions in Greece
seo.description: ASSERT builds AI, computer vision, IoT and custom software solutions that turn real-world data into real-time decisions for public and private organisations.

hero.title: Empowering the physical world with intelligence.
hero.text: ASSERT blends artificial intelligence, computer vision and the Internet of Things with engineering-led software to deliver scalable, real-time systems that see, understand and act.

services_section.title: Six capabilities. One technology partner.
services_section.text: We combine applied AI, computer vision, IoT, software engineering and consulting to take organisations from the first requirement to a system running in production.

loop.title: Sense. Understand. Act.
loop.text: We bridge the gap between sensing and reasoning — building systems that turn raw signals into decisions, so people can focus on outcomes, not data noise.

steps.title: Sense
steps.text: Cameras, sensors and connected devices capture what is happening in the physical world — reliably, securely and in real time.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: AI and computer-vision models turn video, telemetry and documents into structured, trustworthy insight, at the edge or in the cloud.

steps.title: Act
steps.text: Dashboards, alerts, automated workflows and integrations put that insight to work exactly where decisions are made.

industries_section.title: Technology shaped by the environment it operates in.
industries_section.text: Reusable engineering capabilities, combined with an understanding of each sector’s users, regulations and operational realities.

products_section.title: We build technology, not presentations.
products_section.text: Our products turn domain knowledge, connected data and AI into practical tools for specialised markets.

stack.title: Modern engineering, selected for the problem.
stack.text: Proven technologies that can be maintained, integrated and scaled long after launch.

cta.title: Have a technology challenge worth solving?
cta.text: Bring us the problem. We’ll help shape the requirements, choose the architecture and build the solution.
